messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: night deploy 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC. Runtime bump 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 and lightweight model-store migration for Dedicated. Change window 60m, canary in eu-west for 10m then stagger to us-west. Need short statuspage + customer email.

Maya: Ill draft. Abort if canary error rate >1% or p95 latency +300ms. On abort we pin affected Dedicated tenants to 1.3.2 and notify.

Tess: Ops preflight list:
- 22:25 snapshot model-store
- 22:40 pre-warm caches
- 22:50 stop non-critical batch jobs
- 22:55 smoke tests (scripts/smoke_inference.sh)
If preflight fails we won't start.

Oren: Oncall ready. Rollback quick path: manual hold -> ops/rollback_runtime.sh -> pin tenants -> post incident with "degraded" template.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by ravi: start=2026-03-21T23:00Z, canary=10m, regions=[eu-west,us-west], window=60m.

Maya: Statuspage draft:
"Planned maintenance: 21 Mar 2026 23:00 UTC (eu-west, us-west). We will upgrade the inference runtime. Window up to 60 minutes. Some Dedicated pools may be pinned to previous runtime (v1.3.2) if instability is detected. Impact: brief elevated latency or transient errors for a subset of customers."

Ravi: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: inference runtime upgrade  21 Mar 23:00 UTC". Include enterprise carve-out contact: support@redwood.ai and phone. Also note we will not auto-retry model uploads during migration; ops will handle retries after validation.

Tess: I'll post statuspage and queue email to dedicated-cust at 22:00 and 22:45. On start, paste deploy log here and update every +5m.

Oren: I'll monitor canary and first 30m. If DeployBot reports errors I'll flip manual hold and call thread.
